mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.name AS teacherName, u.phone AS teacherPhone, u.email AS teacherEmail, COALESCE(f.unit_count, 0) AS courseUnitCount FROM Teach t JOIN Course c ON t.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN User u ON c.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS unit_count FROM Folder GROUP BY course_id ) f ON f.course_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
